every capability_definition_digest binds the admitted CapabilityDefinition
selected Provider kind is allowed and its conformance covers the resolved capability
every Sandbox required_capabilities entry is covered by its Sandbox ProviderRevision conformance
all selected ProviderRevisions have a latest certified admission decision at admission

request_binding exactly matches the consumed ExecutionGrant request_contract_id, request_digest_profile and request_digest
agent_runtime.resolution_id references exactly one capability_resolution whose admitted ProviderRevision kind is agent_runtime
the AgentRun runtime_provider_resolution_id equals agent_runtime.resolution_id
all selected Agent Runtime, Sandbox and Experience revisions remain immutable for the Run
each Sandbox resolution_id references exactly one capability_resolution whose selected ProviderRevision kind is sandbox
sandbox_slot_key is unique within the sandboxes array
primary_sandbox_slot_key is absent when sandboxes is empty and otherwise references exactly one sandboxes item
selected_experiences exactly match the admitted WorkOrder selections and immutable Catalog revisions
every selected experience ProviderRevision is certified and conformant for its capability
tenant_id and conversation binding match the WorkOrder, input message and ExecutionGrant
conversation WorkspaceRevision matches the admitted branch head captured for this Run
agent_run_id and workflow_run_id match the immutable AgentRun and WorkflowRun records
input, context_package and artifact_access_requirements are the complete bounded execution inputs admitted for this Run
execution_budget, policy_decision and effective_permissions are immutable initial ceilings; short-lived RuntimeAuthorization revisions may remain equal or narrow them without changing the RunManifest
gateway_bindings and authorization_renewal_policy are complete, typed and immutable for this Run
commercial_authorization binds the exact immutable ID, digest and expiration ceiling while event_registry binds its exact immutable ID, version and digest
orchestration_binding equals the WorkflowRun binding and contains no engine-native endpoint or mutable infrastructure identity
tenant_id, workflow_run_id, work_order_id, agent_run_id and runtime_run_id match the immutable execution topology
workspace_revision_id and workspace_revision_digest match the RunManifest branch Workspace head
sandbox_bindings exactly match the RunManifest Sandbox slots and may be empty when the Scenario does not require a Sandbox
request_digest is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 over the request excluding request_digest
input carries the actual bounded input or an immutable platform reference and matches input_message_id
context_package and gateway_bindings exactly match the RunManifest while runtime_authorization binds fresh ArtifactGrants and values equal to or narrower than the immutable admission ceilings
runtime_authorization is unexpired, belongs to this RuntimeRun, RunManifest and InvocationAttempt, and covers every ArtifactAccessRequirement
the Provider rejects an encoded body above admission_limits.max_encoded_request_bytes before parsing with HTTP 413
the bearer token claims match the request, ProviderRevision, RunManifest, RuntimeAuthorization, InvocationAttempt and fencing_token
a fresh single-use ExecutionGrant binds the exact control request excluding execution_grant
append_input and interrupt compare expected_message_head_version while every action compares expected_active_work_version; neither participates in WorkspaceRevision CAS
append_input and interrupt allocate platform input_id and input_message_id and persist an immutable authorized control input before an AgentRuntime command is emitted
head_message_id is null exactly when head_message_sequence is zero
forked_from_message_id references an immutable prior message on forked_from_branch_id
active_work_order_id references at most one non-terminal WorkOrder for the Branch
message appends compare-and-swap message_head_version, Workspace commits compare-and-swap workspace_head_version, and WorkOrder steering compares active_work_version
branch_version is a read-model ETag only and is not a substitute for the three ownership-specific CAS versions
workspace_head_revision_id and workspace_head_revision_digest bind an immutable WorkspaceRevision for this branch
decision_digest is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 over the resolution excluding decision_digest
resolution_input_digest binds the complete requirements, policy, placement, health and capacity inputs evaluated by resolver_revision
tenant_id, client_app_id and work_order_id define the ownership and execution scope of the decision
identity_dependency explicitly declares whether principal attributes affect selection and principal_context_digest is non-null exactly for principal_context mode
candidate_evaluations contains exactly one selected candidate matching selected_provider_instance_id, selected_provider_audience and selected_provider_revision
resolution_evidence_reference resolves to immutable evidence whose digest equals resolution_evidence_digest
request_digest is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 over the request excluding request_digest
input validates against the immutable admitted CapabilityDefinition input schema digest before dispatch
the request ProviderResolution, ProviderInstance, ProviderRevision and bearer audience exactly match the admitted immutable resolution before execution

execution_budget, policy_decision and effective_permissions carry complete executable values, close over the same Tenant, WorkOrder and CommercialAuthorization, and their self-digests match the operation token

the operation-scoped Capability token matches Tenant, ClientApplication, Principal context, WorkOrder, ProviderResolution, ProviderRevision, InvocationAttempt, Fencing, request digest, policy, budget, permissions and StagingGrant

every input ArtifactGrant and the output ArtifactStagingGrant bind the same Tenant, WorkOrder and InvocationAttempt, do not outlive the request or CommercialAuthorization, and every read, upload or commit requires a separately refreshed Artifact Gateway token
iat <= nbf < exp, exp - iat <= 900 and exp is no later than the Capability request deadline or CommercialAuthorization expiration
authorization_sequence starts at one and renewed operation tokens name the immediate predecessor jti without widening the original Invocation scope
operation and operation_request_digest bind the exact Invoke body, Status target, Cancel body or Event cursor descriptor and cannot authorize another operation
every claim, audience and executable context digest matches the exact CapabilityInvocationRequest, ArtifactStagingGrant and admitted ProviderResolution before execution
request_digest is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 over the cancellation request excluding request_digest
an operation-scoped cancel token binds this request digest and the original Capability Invocation request digest
cancellation intent is idempotent and does not prove cancellation; the platform reconciles outcome_unknown
manifest_digest is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 over the manifest excluding manifest_digest
entry paths are normalized unique relative POSIX paths and case-collision policy is enforced for the target filesystem profile
entry_count equals entries length and total_file_bytes equals the sum of file size_bytes
symlinks are absent when policy is forbid; allowed targets are relative, remain within the Workspace root and cannot traverse through another symlink
requested scopes must be a subset of the authenticated WorkSession and WorkOrder policy
sandbox_slot_key selects exactly one Sandbox slot from the admitted RunManifest and cannot resolve a provider-native Sandbox identity
control, input, clipboard, or file-transfer requires runtime:control; view-only requires runtime:view
platform_managed recording is created by Runtime Gateway and never delegated to the Sandbox Provider as an authorization decision
recording channels are compatible with runtime_type; port_forward is live-only and requires disabled recording
Conversation lifecycle events omit the complete Work context group
events for an executable Turn carry work_order_id, turn_id, branch_id, input_message_id and work_sequence as an all-or-none binding
aggregate sequence and WorkOrder work_sequence are independent monotonic ledgers
dedupe_key is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 over tenant_id, producer_id, source_stream_id and source_event_id
Inbox uniqueness on tenant_id plus producer_id plus source_stream_id plus source_event_id rejects source retries before Projection
producer_kind explicitly determines whether provider_revision_id and provider_instance_id are required or forbidden
event_registry identifies the immutable Platform Core Event Registry revision that admits type and data_version
the unique idempotency scope is tenant_id plus client_app_id plus operation_id plus idempotency_key_digest
the same scoped key with a different request_digest is rejected as a conflict and never re-executed
nbf <= iat + 30
iat < exp
exp - iat <= 300
request_contract_id identifies the exact submitted request schema and request_digest is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 over that request excluding only execution_grant
principal_context_digest matches principal_context, whose Tenant, Principal and ClientApplication fields match the Grant claims

turn requests bind conversation, turn, branch, client_message and scenario while control requests bind only conversation, branch, WorkOrder and control_request to the submitted request and authenticated path context
limits and capabilities do not exceed commercial_authorization
the Grant validity window is fully covered by principal_context and commercial_authorization validity windows
authorization_digest is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 over the authorization excluding authorization_digest
authorization revisions are append-only, sequence without gaps and bind the exact predecessor digest
the first authorization equals the RunManifest budget, policy and permission ceilings; later revisions may only remain equal or narrow them
the embedded budget, policy and permissions bind the same Tenant and WorkOrder, and the policy binds the same CommercialAuthorization, budget and permissions digests
commercial authorization, Tenant, WorkOrder, RuntimeRun and RunManifest bindings never change across renewal
expires_at is later than issued_at and no later than the CommercialAuthorization, budget, policy and every ArtifactGrant expiry; no ArtifactGrant predates authorization issuance or outlives it
fresh ArtifactGrants exactly cover admitted ArtifactAccessRequirements without granting finalize authority
grant_digest is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 over the grant excluding grant_digest

expires_at is later than issued_at; a Runtime grant remains inside RuntimeAuthorization while a Capability grant is a non-bearer requirement bounded by its request deadline and CommercialAuthorization and every use requires a shorter Artifact Gateway operation token
the grant is Tenant, WorkOrder, InvocationAttempt, immutable ArtifactVersion and Artifact Gateway route bound
Providers may read admitted versions or write staging content but never finalize an ArtifactVersion
grant_digest is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 over the grant excluding grant_digest
the grant binds one Tenant, WorkOrder and Capability InvocationAttempt and its artifact Gateway binding matches the admitted RunManifest route
expires_at is later than issued_at and no later than the Capability request deadline or CommercialAuthorization expiration; each use also requires a shorter-lived Artifact Gateway operation token
the Provider may upload and commit quarantined staging objects within the declared media, count and byte limits but cannot finalize an ArtifactVersion
iat <= nbf < exp, exp - iat <= 300 and exp is no later than the bound ArtifactGrant or ArtifactStagingGrant
aud and gateway_binding_digest match the admitted artifact Gateway Port and request_digest binds the exact HTTP operation descriptor
read_content requires an ArtifactGrant with read permission while staging operations require an ArtifactStagingGrant and neither token can finalize an ArtifactVersion
request_digest is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 over the request excluding request_digest and content_base64 and equals the Artifact Gateway token request_digest
the decoded content_base64 length and SHA-256 digest exactly match size_bytes and digest before the object is accepted into quarantine
request_digest is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 over the request excluding request_digest and equals the operation-scoped Artifact Gateway token request_digest
every object was uploaded under the same unexpired StagingGrant and the object count, media types and cumulative bytes remain within the grant
commit makes immutable quarantined StagedArtifact metadata visible but never finalizes an ArtifactVersion
principal_context_digest is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 over the snapshot excluding principal_context_digest
expires_at is later than issued_at and the snapshot is immutable once referenced by a Grant, WorkOrder or ProviderResolution
credentials, secrets and mutable display-profile fields are forbidden from the snapshot
an enabled binding carries one typed executable Port whose gateway_kind equals the outer kind while a disabled binding carries no routable identity
model and tool Ports use capability-provider-v1, Artifact uses artifact-gateway-v1 and Egress uses egress-gateway-v1
a gateway required by ExecutionBudget or EffectivePermissions is enabled; disabled bindings are fail-closed and cannot be bypassed by a Provider
model and tool routes use capability-provider-v1, artifact routes use artifact-gateway-v1 and egress routes use egress-gateway-v1
contract_digest equals the admitted immutable OpenAPI artifact and audience is the only accepted bearer-token audience for this route
request_digest is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 over the request excluding request_digest and equals the operation-scoped Egress token request_digest
destination_id resolves to one immutable pre-registered origin and redirects, DNS answers and every connected IP remain within policy
forbidden hop-by-hop, credential and host headers are rejected and the body digest and decoded size are verified before dispatch
iat <= nbf < exp and exp - iat <= 300
aud and gateway_binding_digest match the admitted Egress Gateway Port while every execution and request claim matches the exact EgressHttpRequest
destination_id is present in EffectivePermissions and the request cannot supply or override a raw origin
output validates against the request-bound output_schema_digest before platform acceptance
staged artifacts are quarantined until digest, size, media policy and InvocationAttempt bindings pass finalize checks
Provider usage contains UsageObservation only; Platform creates immutable TechnicalUsageEntry ledger rows after validation
observation_id is idempotent within one ProviderRevision and InvocationAttempt
meter unit matches the admitted MeterDefinition and evidence_reference resolves to bytes matching evidence_digest
partial or estimated observations remain explicitly incomplete when normalized into Platform TechnicalUsage
